shortDescription: Manage tablespaces in an Oracle database

options.name: bigfile
options.description: Should the tablespace be created as a bigfile tablespace

options.name: content
options.description: The type of tablespace (permanent, temporary or undo)

options.name: datafile
options.description: Where to put the datafile. Can be an ASM diskgroup or a filesystem datafile (i.e '+DATA', '/u01/oradata/testdb/test01.dbf') mutually_exclusive with numfiles

options.name: maxsize
options.description: If autoextend, the maximum size of the datafile (1M, 50M, 1G etc). If empty, defaults to database limits

options.name: nextsize
options.description: If autoextend, the size of the next extent allocated (1M, 50M, 1G etc)

options.name: numfiles
options.description: If OMF (db_create_file_dest) is set, you can just specify the number of datafiles you want attached to the tablespace mutually_exclusive with datafile

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the datafile (10M, 10G, 150G etc)

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the tablespace

options.name: tablespace
options.description: The tablespace that should be managed
